ic_name: HDMI / DVI TMDS (TI TFP410 PanelBus Digital Transmitter — subset)
module_role: DVI 1.0 / HDMI video-only transmitter. Sits between a graphics controller's parallel RGB pixel interface (24-bit single-edge or 12-bit dual-edge with DE/HSYNC/VSYNC/CTL) and the DVI / HDMI connector. Encodes per-pixel RGB to 10-bit T.M.D.S. characters, serialises onto 3 differential data pairs + 1 differential clock pair, drives current-mode differential outputs to a DVI/HDMI receiver across a twisted-pair cable. Optional sideband I2C target/DDC bridge for register access + EDID/HDCP transport.

integration_overview.wire_count_sideband: 5 typical (SCL + SDA for DDC/I2C + HPD/HTPLG + RSEN via MSEN + reset/ISEL)
integration_overview.wire_directions: TMDS data + clock pairs: source → sink (unidirectional). Sideband I2C: bidirectional. HPD: sink → source. RSEN: source-side passive sense.
integration_overview.no_chip_select: TMDS is point-to-point; no CS on the TMDS wires.
integration_overview.no_addressing_on_TMDS: No device address on TMDS; one transmitter ↔ one receiver per link.
integration_overview.addressing_on_I2C: TFP410 self register file at base 0b0111_A3A2A1 (A[3:1] pin-strap); DDC EDID at 0x50; HDCP at 0x3A (cipher outside TFP410 scope).
integration_overview.controller_choices: Graphics controller is the universal pixel source; TFP410 is the TMDS PHY + encoder bridge.
integration_overview.handshake_at_protocol_layer: None on TMDS — fire-and-forget streaming. I2C uses standard ACK/NAK + arbitration.

interface_categories: Parallel input interface (DATA[23:0] or DATA[11:0] + DE + HSYNC + VSYNC + CTL[3:1] + IDCK±)
Voltage / mode select inputs (V_REF + BSEL + DSEL + EDGE + DKEN + DK[3:1] + ISEL/RST + PD)
TMDS output interface (TX0±, TX1±, TX2±, TXC± current-mode differential)
Sideband control I2C target (SCL + SDA when ISEL=1)
DDC bridge over the same I2C wires (for EDID + HDCP transport)
Hot-Plug Detect input (EDGE/HTPLG pin in I2C mode)
Receiver Sense / Monitor Sense output (MSEN open-drain pin)
Power supplies + grounds (DV_DD, PV_DD, TV_DD; DGND, PGND, TGND; TFADJ resistor; NC pin tied HIGH)
interconnect_topologies_supported: Point-to-point DVI: TFP410 → single DVI receiver via Type-D / Type-A DVI cable.
Point-to-point HDMI Type-A connector (video-only — TFP410 does not emit audio data-islands).
TFP410 + external HDCP cipher block + external HDMI audio packetizer = full HDMI 1.x video+audio+HDCP transmitter (system-level integration).
TFP410 + I2C controller in host SoC = combined transmitter + DDC EDID reader.
default_signal_values_when_omitted: If a host omits CTL[3:1] inputs, internal weak pull-downs default them to LOW. NC pin should be tied HIGH. PD defaults to 0 (powered down) after RESET — host must explicitly enable. DE_GEN defaults to 0 (external DE used).
soc_dependent_items: Pixel-clock source on the host side (graphics PLL or controller-provided IDCK).
Choice of input mode: 24-bit single-edge or 12-bit dual-edge.
Choice of input swing: high-swing 3.3 V CMOS or low-swing 1.1-1.8 V (V_REF resistor divider).
Choice of clock mode: single-ended or differential (differential only in low-swing).
I2C controller on host to configure TFP410 + read EDID over DDC.
External R_TFADJ resistor (≈ 510 Ω) on TFADJ pin.
External 5 kΩ pull-ups on SCL/SDA/MSEN (open-drain outputs).
External 1 kΩ pull-up resistor on EDGE/HTPLG (when used as HPD input).
ESD protection on TMDS pins (±4 kV HBM rating built-in; external TVS optional).
DVI/HDMI Type-A or Type-D connector + appropriate cable.
System-level HDCP cipher (if HDCP needed — NOT inside TFP410).
System-level HDMI audio packetizer + InfoFrame encoder (if HDMI audio needed — NOT inside TFP410).

low_power_modes.Power_down_PD_eq_0: Only digital I/O buffers + I2C interface remain active; TMDS drivers + PLL + encoders all gated; minimal current (I_PD ≤ 500 µA typical).
low_power_modes.TDIS_eq_1: TMDS circuitry disabled while PD=1; PLL may stay locked; faster wake-up than full PD.
low_power_modes.VEN_HEN_eq_0: VSYNC / HSYNC inputs transmitted as fixed LOW — does NOT reduce power but disables sync transmission.

typical_use_cases: DVI 1.0-compliant set-top box / DVD player / Blu-ray player output to digital display (up to WUXGA 1920×1200 @ 60 Hz or 1080p).
PC desktop / notebook external video output (single-link DVI or HDMI Type-A).
Reference DVI/HDMI PHY for academic / open-source projects.
